pipeline.role: Copy current source snapshot before worker wait; price-independent rotation and explicit coverage
Validate and persist immutable input+feature frame with account/configuration binding; no orders
Export a pinned complete snapshot prefix instead of unrelated pages
Build/verify through existing harpoon_quant.causal_panel without fitting
Recompute eight existing features, select preregistered grid causally, assign labels only after observed maturity
Later fixed C0/RIDGE/SVR comparison under common controls and separate journal reservation

clocks.market_timestamp: Provider event time; retain as received
clocks.quote_received_at: Actual local receipt recorded by runtime
clocks.snapshot_asof: Time snapshot contents demonstrably existed in memory
clocks.predictor_completion_at: Separate measured completion time; not inferred from snapshot
clocks.historic_retrieval_at: Current retrieval only; cannot recreate old receipt times

allowed_conservative_bar_rule: If an original bar receipt is absent but the bar is inside an immutable real snapshot, the snapshot time is a conservative first-known bound. Label that basis explicitly; it is not a measured per-bar transport timestamp.
prohibited: Historical bar end+3s presented as original reception
Filling unknown L1 quotes or executable depth from OHLCV
Marking reconstructed historical rows as prospective
Treating sample midquote label as trade/net-account PnL
Fabricating model OBSERVED origin or complete-account costs
Using all profitable assets only to build selection
minimum_runtime_inputs: original quotes with market and receipt timestamps
later observed quote/maturity frames for labels
model_comparison_additional_inputs: fixed observed Ridge and SVR model bytes/provenance from admissible training data
same test-period universe, capital, risk and cost model
reserved experiment identity and whole search history
